Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting public service announcements by elected officials during reelection campaigns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting public service announcements byelected officials during reelection campaigns; adding a new section tochapter 42.52 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 42.23 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No stateelected official may speak or appear in a public serviceannouncement that is broadcast, shown, or distributed in any formwhatsoever during the period beginning January 1st and continuingthrough the general election if that official is a candidate. If theofficial does not control the broadcast, showing, or distribution of apublic service announcement in which he or she speaks or appears, thenthe official shall contractually limit the use of the public serviceannouncement to be consistent with this section prior to participatingin the public service announcement. This section does not apply topublic service announcements that are part of the regular duties of theoffice that only mention or visually display the office or office sealor logo and do not mention or visually display the name of the officialin the announcement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No municipal officer may speak or appear in a public serviceannouncement that is broadcast, shown, or distributed in any formwhatsoever during the period beginning January 1st and continuingthrough the general election if that officer is a candidate. If theofficer does not control the broadcast, showing, or distribution of apublic service announcement in which he or she speaks or appears, thenthe officer shall contractually limit the use of the public serviceannouncement to be consistent with this section prior to participatingin the public service announcement. This section does not apply topublic service announcements that are part of the regular duties of theoffice that only mention or visually display the office or office sealor logo and do not mention or visually display the name of the officerin the announcement.
